turns.user_utterance: I finally got my new card and was very excited to use it today. However, my payment kept declining. What is happening?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—when card payments keep declining, it’s usually a card/payment issue. Can you tell me: was the payment declined at the merchant after you tried to pay, or are you seeing any specific error message (e.g., “do not honor”, “insufficient funds”, or “try again later”)? Also, did you use the new card immediately after receiving it?
